name: Red Maple Village
summary: Red Maple Village is a community shopping center in Tracy, California, managed by Phillips Edison & Company. With a 4.3-star rating from over 500 reviews, it serves as a convenient retail destination for local residents and Central Valley commuters along South Tracy Boulevard.
demographics: Red Maple Village serves the Tracy, California community, attracting primarily middle-income families and working professionals from the growing Central Valley region. The trade area draws from Tracy's diverse population with a median household income typical of suburban California communities, including young families with children and dual-income households. Shoppers in this area tend to prioritize convenience and value, seeking everyday necessities and family-oriented retail options. The center benefits from Tracy's position as a commuter city between the Bay Area and Central Valley, serving both local residents and pass-through traffic along the South Tracy Boulevard corridor.
description: Red Maple Village is a community shopping center strategically located at 2550 South Tracy Boulevard in Tracy, California, serving as a convenient retail destination for the growing Central Valley community. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, a nationally recognized shopping center REIT specializing in grocery-anchored centers, Red Maple Village provides essential retail and services to local residents and commuters traveling through this dynamic region. The center has earned a strong reputation among shoppers, reflected in its impressive 4.3-star rating from over 517 Google reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and community engagement. Operating daily from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Red Maple Village offers accessible shopping hours that accommodate the busy schedules of working families and professionals in the Tracy area. As part of Phillips Edison's portfolio of neighborhood and community centers, Red Maple Village exemplifies the company's commitment to creating vibrant retail destinations that serve the everyday needs of their communities while providing quality spaces for local and national retailers to thrive.
